name: Ageing Monday
office_task: Every Monday, publish the accounts receivable ageing report from the ledger, every figure with its definition, source and as-of time, and say so when one cannot be read.
systems_of_record: the ledger (Xero or MYOB): aged receivables by due date
the job system (ServiceM8 or Simpro): completed jobs not yet invoiced
the system the report is published into, which issues the report_id

emits.write: one view of the week's ageing report per audience (owner, lender), each figure carrying its definition id, source and as-of time, or published as unavailable with the reason; a correction is a new version superseding the old, with the named person and the reason
emits.readback: reading the period's reports back returns each report_id with its version, published_at and published_by; no id back means it was not published and report.publish_failed is raised

emits.write: an exception naming the definition's owner or the threshold's person: a source that could not be read, a measure with no definition or two, a threshold that could not be compared, a correction missing a person or reason, or a view that did not read back
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the period, the measure, the reason and the exception_owner

port_of.original_name: Send weekly AR ageing reports with Invoice Ninja, PDFMint and Gmail
